> Issues are for reproducible bugs only. For product ideas, RFCs, and usage questions, use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/LeoLiao0806Xuan/Fractal_Chat/discussions).

**What happened?**

A concise description of the incorrect behavior.

**To Reproduce**

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

**Expected behavior**

A clear description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots**

If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Environment**

- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14.5]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 125, Firefox 128]
- Fractal Chat version or commit: [e.g. commit SHA]
- Model provider type: [e.g. OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic; do not include keys]

**Additional context**

Add any other context about the problem here.

> Do not include API keys, authorization headers, private conversation content, or personal data. Reduce examples to the minimum needed to reproduce the bug.
